message.content:
This editorial illustration features a dark green background with "TEMPO" in large red block letters at the top. Below this, two men sit holding large gold-colored brass tubas. On the left, a man in a yellow blazer sits hunched, holding his instrument. On the right, a man in a gray suit smiles while holding his tuba. In the foreground, a third man seen from the back, wearing a dark suit with white cuffs, acts as a conductor. His hands are raised, right hand holding a white baton and left hand gesturing with fingers curled.

A music stand in front of him holds a white sheet of paper showing a black silhouette of a person’s profile next to the text "2++". A disembodied hand from the left edge of the frame reaches out to touch the paper. Large white text on the lower right reads "MALU-MAU MENUNDA PEMILU" above a smaller paragraph of Indonesian text. Other headlines include "Tipu Daya Judi Opsi Biner" and "Perang Rusia-Ukraina di Mata Dua Duta Besar". A barcode and date "7-13 MARET 2022" appear in the top right corner.
